summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir declared zero tolerance for Hezbollah terror infrastructure in southern Lebanon, vowing immediate forceful response to any entrenchment. Iran conducted multiple ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and Shiraz, launched a UAV from Urmia, and claimed downing an MQ-1 drone near Sirik. sections.executive_summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir declared zero tolerance for Hezbollah terror infrastructure in southern Lebanon, vowing immediate forceful response to any entrenchment. Iran conducted multiple ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and Shiraz, launched a UAV from Urmia, and claimed downing an MQ-1 drone near Sirik. Israeli strikes in Gaza killed six Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives, including a Nukhba company commander and senior military intelligence chief Jamal Abu Said.

points: Iran conducted a ballistic missile test launch from Sanandaj in Kurdistan Province, described as a test by the IRGC-linked monitoring channel. (Source: @shin_persian/11992)
A second ballistic missile launch occurred from Shiraz in Fars Province, also reported by the same Iranian monitoring source with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11994)
The IRGC launched a UAV from Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province at 15:50 local time (1220Z), tracked by open-source monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/11999)
IRGC claims to have downed an MQ-1 drone near Sirik in Hormozgan Province, asserting the shootdown via official channels. (Source: @shin_persian/12002)
Jet activity detected in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province at 15:55 local time (1225Z), indicating possible air force readiness or exercises. (Source: @shin_persian/11997)

Iran's Supreme Leader stated the US seeks Iran's unconditional surrender, vowed no concessions, said US election changes won't alter hostility, praised the Axis of Resistance from Palestine to Yemen, and warned renewed US aggression would trigger a broader Iranian response. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9571)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir visited the northern border and declared the military "will not allow Hezbollah to establish terror infrastructure" in southern Lebanon, stating any attempt to entrench, build capabilities, or threaten northern communities will be met immediately and forcefully. (Source: @manniefabian/59481)

IDF and Shin Bet announced six Palestinian operatives killed in Gaza strikes this week: in Khan Younis, Hamas sniper cell commander Mahmoud Jihad Mohammad Qafa and Army of Islam member Asaad Suleiman Salman Qashta (smuggling facilitator) killed Monday; on Sunday, Hamas cell commander Mohammad Zakaria Al-Jamal, Hamas operative Mohammad Amin Al-Namas, Nukhba Force company commander Shaher Mohammad Zaarab, and Islamic Jihad sniper Mohammad Ali Abu Shaar killed. (Source: @shin_persian/11989)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Jamal Abu Said, head of Hamas military intelligence operations department, in an airstrike in Gaza City on Sunday; he previously commanded an anti-tank battalion, trained operatives abroad, managed Hamas foreign relations, and during the ceasefire advanced attacks and rebuilt military capabilities. (Source: @yediotnews25/137297)
IDF identified Hamas leader Mohammed Deif and other top commanders entering tunnels on the eve of October 7, per a Times of Israel report. (Source: @manniefabian/59483)
An Apache attack helicopter was spotted heading toward northern occupied Palestine, per Lebanese open-source alert channel. (Source: @redlinkleb/51731)
Israeli warplanes were active over south Lebanon, shown on live mapping by the same alert channel. (Source: @redlinkleb/51758)

Six Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives killed in Israeli strikes in Khan Younis and Gaza City this week, including a Nukhba Force company commander, a Hamas sniper cell commander, and an Islamic Jihad sniper. (Source: @shin_persian/11989)

Lebanese health ministry confirmed one killed (Muhammad Nasser Yousef) and one wounded in Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Qabrikha, south Lebanon. (Source: @manniefabian/59480)
Initial reports indicate two wounded in the Qabrikha motorcycle strike, likely Hezbollah operatives. (Source: @yediotnews25/137298)

Iran's Supreme Leader referenced the "Axis of Resistance" extending from Palestine and Lebanon to Iraq and Yemen in his statement, but no specific operational activity in Syria or Iraq was reported in the messages. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9571)
UAE National Center of Meteorology aircraft returned to Al Hajar and Fujairah after apparent cloud-seeding operations, per flight tracking. (Source: @shin_persian/12005)

sections.threat_assessment: Israel is enforcing a strict red line against Hezbollah reconstitution in southern Lebanon while simultaneously degrading Hamas command structures in Gaza through targeted killings of mid-level commanders and intelligence chiefs. Iran is demonstrating missile and UAV capabilities across multiple provinces and claiming a drone shootdown, signaling readiness to contest airspace. The Supreme Leader's rhetoric indicates a hardened posture against US pressure, with explicit linkage of regional proxies. The concurrent Israeli operations in Lebanon and Gaza, coupled with Iranian weapons testing, suggest a high risk of miscalculation or deliberate escalation across multiple fronts.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese health ministry and local reports confirm casualties from Israeli strikes, while Lebanese open-source alert channels track Israeli air activity. Iran's official and semi-official channels publicize missile tests and drone shootdown claims, projecting deterrence. The UAE conducts weather modification operations unrelated to conflict. No direct responses from Syria, Iraq, or Gulf states beyond Iran's Axis of Resistance framing were captured in the data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed reporting of Iranian missile and UAV launches suggests a monitoring network with access to launch detection. Israeli strikes in Gaza show precise targeting of named commanders across Hamas and PIJ, indicating sustained intelligence penetration. The elimination of Jamal Abu Said, a hostage-holding intelligence chief, represents a significant blow to Hamas's external operations and hostage management. Iranian missile tests from both western (Sanandaj) and southern (Shiraz) sites demonstrate geographic depth of launch capabilities.
